Hello Matt,
 

 Thank you for your message. We have just added the requested item to your existing order and have sent you an adjustment invoice in a separate email, which you can pay using the provided link.
 

 But instead of charging you full price for the scarf, we thought of something better: putting a $25 gift card there for $20 instead of nothing. You still pay about the same amount as if we charged you full price, but instead you get a little something to make a future purchase or give to someone in your family for all the effort they put in their monarch habitats 😉
 

 Please let us know if that works for you! 😊
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-founder 
 Lasclay
